overview: A polished pseudo-3D isometric action-puzzle game where a cute big-nosed creature hops diagonally across a pyramid of cubes, turning every top face to the target color while dodging enemies and grabbing power-ups.
features: Hop diagonally across a 3D pyramid of cubes to change their color
Escalating color rules and special blocks (ice, sticky, teleporter, booster)
Roster of enemies including egg-hatching snakes, side-crawlers, and falling balls
Power-ups like invincibility, speed boost, and freeze ray
Gems, combo scoring, and escalating arcade levels
Pseudo-3D isometric view with a free-orbit camera option
